common.title: SANGYAN Investor Resilience
common.tagline: We don't predict markets. We show, with simple maths and cited sources, why unrealistic returns cannot be real.
common.disclaimer: Educational tool. Not investment advice. Not a legal document.
common.privacyNotice: Privacy by design: No personal identifiers, phone numbers, or account details are ever stored or logged. Data is masked directly on your device before any external processing.

home.heroSubtitle: Received a high-return offer on WhatsApp or Telegram? Check the math, find red flags, and know the official channels to report.
home.checkCardDesc: Paste a message, link, or upload a screenshot to detect scam patterns and calculate annualised return.
home.calcCardDesc: Convert promised returns to real annualised percentages and compare with official savings and market benchmarks.
home.learnCardDesc: Understand compounding, volatility, and regulatory protections in Hindi, Tamil, and English.
home.reportCardDesc: Step-by-step guidance for the first 60 minutes after a suspected fraud. Draft an official incident record.
home.askCardDesc: Ask questions about investment schemes and get answers strictly grounded in official sources.
